Eleni Z.: Quick notice: were publishing a docs + small-shim path for an SDK param validation change hitting v4. Short summary and action items below.
Marcus D.: whats the user-visible break?
Eleni Z.: v4 will enforce exact param names and remove a couple legacy aliases (e.g., `resp_format`). Calls that relied on loose coercion (like passing boolean `truncate=True`) may fail.
Rosa V.: ok. Can teams opt out quickly?
Eleni Z.: Two immediate options: pin to latest v3 patch or add the compat shim. Pin example: `redwood-sdk==3.16.0` or "@redwood/inference": "3.16.0".
docs-bot: Migration doc + shim: https://docs.redwood.ai/sdk/compat-shim (includes CI lint, canary checklist)
Marcus D.: CI checks?
Eleni Z.: Yes  `pip install redwood-compat-lint` then `redwood-compat-lint --check src/`; we also included a GH Actions snippet in the guide.
Rosa V.: how long will shim be supported?
Eleni Z.: 90 days from v4 GA. Well publish exact sunset dates in the guide.
Marcus D.: who to contact if we hit a blocker during rollout?
Eleni Z.: Ping me (@eleni) or #eng-runtime, open an `sdk-compat` issue in infra.
Rosa V.: thanks, will add lint to CI and run the quick fingerprint query from the playbook.
Eleni Z.: TL;DR: pin if you need zero changes; otherwise use the shim + follow the checklist. Will post the docs PR in #docs shortly. :thumbsup:
